Matches the recorded 2026-07-26 precedent.

Fixed by a deterministic re-wrap script that wrapped each element in {"drafts":[obj]} with the brain's content byte-identical - an envelope repair, NOT an edit to the brain's answer. Worth an F-item: extract --recorded reports '0 findings, 0 dropped' rather than erroring on a malformed element shape.
